name: God Loves Everyone
overview: Scripture reveals that God's love extends to all people without partiality, as Peter declares that God is no respecter of persons (Acts 10:34). This universal love is demonstrated supremely in Christ's sacrificial death for sinners (Romans 5:8) and God's giving of His only begotten Son so that whoever believes in Him may have eternal life (John 3:16). Believers are called to respond by loving God and others, including neighbors and even enemies, reflecting the greatest commandments to love God and love others as oneself (Proverbs 8:17; Matthew 5:43; Mark 12:31).
